items.title: 1. MDMA: Magnesium Alarm, the first paragraph: what a tense jaw means, and what you have seen
items.your_version: With MDMA, I treat jaw tension as the earliest warning that the body needs more magnesium. I don't have studies to back this up, but everyone I know who has taken enough magnesium chloride to make the jaw tension fully release has avoided the MDMA toxicity symptoms they get otherwise.

items.my_version: With MDMA, I treat meaningful jaw tension as the earliest warning that the body needs more magnesium. This comes from repeated field experience rather than a direct clinical trial. Everyone I know who has taken enough magnesium chloride to make the jaw tension fully release has avoided the other complications I have seen when people let that tension continue.

items.title: 2. MDMA: Magnesium Alarm, your second wife's story and what you took from it
items.your_version: My second wife had severe convulsions after an MDMA overdose. At the hospital,  they figured out what caused that: her potassium was found to be critically low, and IV potassium was the only treatment they gave her. That experience is what leads me to treat serious MDMA toxicity as a broader electrolyte emergency, although magnesium is still the first and most useful supplement to give once the jaw tenses, since potassium gets depleted after magnesium.
